name: v2.3.2
body:
## Highlights 💡

### More reliable HMR, fewer full-page reloads

HMR now handles code-splitting changes more reliably, reducing unnecessary full-page reloads when chunks are added or rearranged. Newly required chunks are loaded before HMR accept callbacks run, and changes to async chunk dependencies no longer cause unnecessary update propagation. 

### Experimental `rule.as`

The experimental `rule.as` option lets a matched resource use a different path for subsequent rule matching while preserving the original resource for file reading and loaders. For example, `as: '[resource-path].txt'` lets later `.txt` rules also process `example.source.js`. ([#15917](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15917))

```js
// rspack.config.mjs
export default {
  module: {
    rules: [
      {
        test: /\.source\.js$/,
        type: 'asset/source',
        as: '[resource-path].txt',
      },
      { test: /\.txt$/, use: './text-loader.js' },
    ],
  },
};
```

Here, `example.source.js` matches the later `.txt` rule as `example.source.js.txt`; `text-loader.js` still receives the contents of the original file.

### Skip side-effect-free `export *` passthrough modules

Rspack can now bypass side-effect-free modules that only forward exports with `export *`, connecting directly to the underlying module. [#16472](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16472)

Mark the package as side-effect-free in `package.json`:

```json
{
  "sideEffects": false
}
```

```js
// src/value.js
export const value = 42;

// src/passthrough.js
export * from './value.js';

// src/index.js
export * from './passthrough.js';
```

With `optimization.sideEffects` enabled (the default in production), the `export *` connection from `index.js` can now go directly to `value.js`, skipping `passthrough.js`.

* perf(core): trim runtime spec sets on creation by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16478
